purpose: Source audit for 400–700 nm MgF2/TiO2 thin-film reflectors on bulk fused silica. No ZnS in the selected material system. Research calculation, not manufacturing calibration.

materials.source_comments_verbatim: Film TiO<sub>2</sub>; Deposited by e-beam evaporation on c-Si; 99.6 nm thick film with an amorphous (very fine polycrystalline) structure; Heterogenous data processing combining ellipsometric and spectrophotometric measurements; Room temperature.
materials.use: selected baseline high-index thin-film layer; e-beam deposited representative sample, not a universal TiO2 constant
materials.primary_title: Dispersion model for optical thin films applicable in wide spectral range

sample.deposition_temperature: not stated in the RII source

materials.source_representation: author-supplied tabulated nk; universal dispersion-model reconstruction from combined ellipsometric and spectrophotometric data
materials.k_status: The source provides nonzero fitted/model k over 400–700 nm. Preserve actual k values. Tiny red-visible k values are model predictions, not a claim of independent absorption measurement at 1e-7 to 1e-10 sensitivity; not measured exact zero.

materials.source_comments_verbatim:
Film: prepared by ALD, 350 nm TiO2. See Ratzsch et al. Nanotechnology 26, 024003 (2015).
Measurement: ellipsometer Jobin Yvon UVISEL2 VUV: 1.5–8.7 eV; ellipsometer Jobin Yvon UVISEL: 0.6–6.5 eV; ellipsometer Woollam IRVASE: 300–6500 cm-1; spectrophotometer McPhersom VUVas 2000: 5.6–10.3 eV; spectrophotometer Perkin Elmer Lambda 1050: 0.5-6.7 eV; spectrophotometer Bruker Vertex 80v: 80-7500 cm-1.
Fit model: universal dispersion model. See Franta et al. Appl. Opt. 54, 9108–9119 (2015)."
materials.use: secondary cross-sample/process sensitivity: ALD film, not interchangeable with the e-beam Franta baseline

sample.deposition_temperature_source: primary full paper, Section 3; 350 denotes thickness in nm, not deposition temperature

materials.primary_title: Universal dispersion model for characterization of optical thin films over wide spectral range: Application to magnesium fluoride
materials.source_representation: tabulated nk supplied by Daniel Franta; universal dispersion-model reconstruction from combined ellipsometric and spectrophotometric data
materials.k_status: Source supplies nonzero fitted/model k. Very small visible k values are predictions of the fitted wide-band dispersion model, not evidence of independently measured absorption at 1e-15 to 1e-19 sensitivity and not measured exact zero.
assumptions: Use the source-supplied k without replacing it by zero.
Do not generalize this sample to arbitrary deposition conditions.

materials.use: bulk fused-silica substrate, not silica thin-film layer
materials.primary_title: Interspecimen comparison of the refractive index of fused silica
materials.source_representation: n-only Sellmeier formula; no k DATA block
materials.k_status: k is not reported by this dataset. Any k=0 used in simulation must be labeled an explicit transparent-substrate/lossless assumption, not measured zero.
assumptions: Use only as bulk fused-silica substrate.
For 400–700 nm substrate calculations, k=0 is an explicit lossless modeling assumption; Malitson supplies n only.
Use scalar effective thin-film nk as tabulated by the author; do not substitute ordinary/extraordinary bulk rutile constants.
No high-index TiO2 k zeroing, clipping or extrapolation within 400–700 nm.
Data were copied exactly from the bundled pinned snapshot and their computed Git blob SHA1 matched GitHub fetch_file responses at the pinned upstream commit.
Linear interpolation in wavelength independently for n and k. Display precision does not imply experimental precision.
MgF2-Franta keeps its finite fitted/model k. SiO2-Malitson is n only; lossless bulk substrate k=0 remains an explicit modeling assumption, not measured zero.
retrieval_notes: Franta paper metadata and model description verified in the Masaryk University author/institution record; the SPIE DOI resolver was not accessible via web tool, so no additional full-paper details were inferred.
Siefke primary full paper was read via publisher, Section 3, verifying 100 C deposition using TTIP and oxygen plasma. No source support was found for a 350 C temperature.
Zhukovsky 20 nm sample is not the selected baseline because its finite k400 is more than ten times Franta/Siefke at the sampled wavelength.

Jolivet amorphous/anatase and Sarkar films were inspected as extra alternatives. Their pinned YAML k is exactly zero at 400–700 nm; without the source fit and detection-limit qualifications, they were not selected as measured-zero low-loss evidence.
Kischkat visible nk was not used: its tabulated nk starts at 1.53846 um and does not cover the requested visible band.
